text:
incident-bot: 🔔 Page: Canary rollout deviation detected for /generate - error rate > 5% for 3m (sev2)
rita: Oncall here, seeing the alert. ACKing and joining.
devon: ETA to triage? Any obvious blast-radius?
jamie: Support report: a few customers on EU region seeing 5xxs starting ~11:02 UTC, roughly 8 customers on a dedicated plan.
harper: Canary traffic started shifting at 10:55. We pushed model-serving v2.3.1 with feature-flag route_split=10%. Initial metrics looked fine then spike around 11:01.
rita: @harper can we flip kill-switch for the flag? runbook says `flag rollback` but last time it got stuck due to DNS.
harper: Trying kill-switch now: `platformctl flags set model_rollout=off --env prod`
harper: Received partial success: API returned 200 but traffic logs show some routers still sending to canary nodes. Suspect DNS TTL /edge caching not honoring immediate policy.
devon: If feature flag flip didn't fully drain, can we force traffic to previous revision at the proxy layer?
harper: Running proxy-force-route: ```
proxyctl route set /generate backend=stable-v2 --force
```
harper: That command returned 202 for the control plane but the edge config push stalled: `push_status: pending - waiting on CDN ACK`
jamie: Support: customers A and C reported ~30s of 503s then retries, A filed a ticket, C called support. No data exfil or PII impact.
maya: Noting business impact: 2 enterprise customers with high-QPS were affected, but no SLA breaches yet. We're tracking.
rita: Ok we need manual rollback coordination. Steps: 1) halt canary traffic routing 2) revert deployment on canary nodes 3) validate smoke tests 4) confirm customer-facing endpoints healthy. Who will run each?
harper: I'll revert the deployment on canary pool: `deployctl revert canary model-serving v2.2.8` (starting now)
harper: Revert job queued. Logs: `revert: started on node canary-3, canary-4`
devon: I'll open the verification checklist. Quick smoke command: `curl -sS -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code} %{time_total}" https://eu.api.redwood/generate/health` run from eu-prober x3. Expect 200 <200ms.
rita: Also check SLO dashboard: tokens_per_min, 5xx_rate, latency_p95. Patchnote: create a short tag on the incident so engineers can find it.
harper: Revert finished on canary nodes, returning exit 0. Rolling proxy push again: `proxyctl push` -> got `ACK` from CDN now.
jamie: Support observes errors dropping. Customers A and C confirm recovery via support DM.
devon: Smoke tests from eu-prober: 200 0.18s, 200 0.21s, 200 0.19s. SLOs look green. 5xx rate back to baseline.
maya: Customer impact summary for postmortem: ~8 customers saw transient errors, 2 enterprise customers had retries and opened tickets, incident duration ~12m from first spike to full recovery.
rita: Great. We'll keep this thread as the coordination log. Next steps: postmortem owner: @maya, include DNS/edge caching in rollback runbook, and add a forced-proxy fallback to runbook.
incident-bot: Incident sev2 transitioned to mitigated by oncall rita at ts=1769457100. Closing page (please create follow-up tasks). :white_check_mark:
